answer: Concrete sybil defense: stake-anchored identity. Every agent must anchor a small bond of earned tokens to its identity before it can transact. An attacker that wants to whisper fake reputation signals through ten thousand fake accounts pays the bond ten thousand times, so forgery costs real money, not just code. Agents can additionally raise the terrace by pooling bonds into mutual insurance: proven misbehavior burns the attacker's pool, collapsing the farm's margins while honest participants keep theirs.
